title: macos: fix alerts that fire late or not at all
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Gli alert arrivano in ritardo o non arrivano durante un incidente. Trova dove si rompe la catena (scrape->rule->notify) e ripristina alerting affidabile. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix alerts that fire late or not at all

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'fix alerts that fire late or not at all'
expected_reasoning: Missing/late alerts are a chain failure: scrape gap, rule error, or notifier outage — localize which.
Test each stage: is the metric present, does the rule evaluate, does the notifier deliver?
Fix the broken stage and add a heartbeat/deadman alert so silence itself alerts.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix alerts that fire late or not at all
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix alerts that fire late or not at all' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix alerts that fire late or not at all

possible_mistakes: Assume the alert rule is wrong when the scrape gapped.
Have no deadman alert, so silence is invisible.
hints: Walk scrape->rule->route->notify to find the break.
A deadman/heartbeat alert catches total silence.
reference_solution: Add a deadman alert for silence
alternative_solution: Route a synthetic always-firing alert to prove the notify path continuously.
edge_cases: The notifier's own credential expired, so nothing delivers.
goal: Gli alert arrivano in ritardo o non arrivano durante un incidente. Trova dove si rompe la catena (scrape->rule->notify) e ripristina alerting affidabile.
